title: Vector Metadata
description: Additional metadata fields for vector data. Used when data_category is 'vector'.

feature_count.description: Number of features in the dataset

geometry_type.description: OGC geometry type (GeoJSON spelling). A single string when the layer is homogeneous; an array when the layer genuinely holds more than one type, which is common in real vector data. The envelope reports what the layer IS rather than rounding it to one type.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] in the envelope's CRS

total_area_m2.description: Sum of all feature areas in square meters. Useful for quick sanity checks.

id_field.description: Name of the attribute field that uniquely identifies features

attribute_fields.description: List of attribute field names present in the dataset

size_bytes.description: Size of the output file in bytes, measured after it is written (SIZE-1, D-148). Says whether a layer can travel before anyone simplifies it.

vertex_count.description: Total coordinate count across every feature, rings included (SIZE-1, D-148).
